judged_text: The rss.items loop has no per-item error handling, so the first item that raises aborts the entire feed import — most concretely, i.content is nil for feed items with no content element (plain RSS 2.0 feeds that use <description> only), and nil.scrub raises NoMethodError at line 35. One malformed or content-less item permanently halts processing of every item after it; with sidekiq_options retry: false (line 12) the hourly job never retries, so the enabled feed importer imports only a prefix (or nothing, on description-only feeds) each hour with no per-item record of what was dropped — and via TopicRetriever's inline call the same crash also fails every interactive embed retrieval.

adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` with no nil-guard or per-item rescue. If `i.content` is nil for any feed item, `nil.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the entire job mid-feed. The job is configured with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so it won’t automatically retry. Additionally, TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline when `feed_polling_enabled?`, so the same exception can break interactive embed retrieval as well.
